title: A Nonstandard Finite Difference Scheme for a Nonlinear Parabolic Equation with p-Laplacian-Type Diffusion
summary: We propose and analyze a nonstandard finite difference (NSFD) scheme for nonlinear parabolic equations involving a p-Laplacian-type diffusion operator in one- and two-dimensional spatial domains. Following Mickens' design principles, the proposed discretization employs a nonlinear denominator function phi(.) together with a nonlocal approximation of the nonlinear diffusion term Delta_p, yielding a structure-preserving discrete model.
